title: My Wishlist
subtitle: Spoil me and earn my attention
description: This is my curated gift list: clothing, toys, accessories and items I want. Pick something from the list and send it to me directly — it's the most direct way to earn yourself a special place in my attention.

1.title: Open the list
1.text: Click the button and go to my Linktree with all my wishes organized.

2.title: Pick a gift
2.text: Choose whatever you want to spoil me with, from the simplest to the most generous.

3.title: Confirm on WhatsApp
3.text: Let me know what you got me so I can thank you properly.

note: A good gift always opens doors. The more generous you are, the more present you'll be in my mind.
whatsappCta: Let me know I bought something
